ticket.summary: Rewards points not credited after completing weekly survey
ticket.description: Since Monday several panelists in the UK report that points are not added after completing the weekly survey in the app. Example panelist contacted us from jane.doe@example.com. App version 4.2.1 on Android. The survey shows as completed in their history.

comments.author: Service Desk
comments.body: Two more panelists reported the same today.
